Standard bottle packaging is included in the unit production price. Blister packaging, sample packs, relabeling, or market-specific cartons are billable only when the purchase order or written change authorization identifies the packaging format.

An invoice line may be approved only when the billed supplier, product, SKU, batch, milestone, material, capacity period, or shipment can be tied to an authorized source document.

contract_policy_sections.text:
### 2.3 Pending batches

Batches with release status of `pending` may not be invoiced for batch manufacturing, QA release, or line clearance fees.

## 3. Pending batches

Pending batches are not billable for completed production, release testing, or release administration fees. Suppliers may submit informational statements for pending work, but payment approval must wait for release or a contract-defined milestone.

5. Quality release status and test evidence.
6. Milestone approval and deliverable acceptance.
7. Material consumption records and approved unit costs.
8. Capacity reservation and utilization records.

## 3. Stability study windows

1. Contract terms and pricing schedules.
2. Purchase orders and approved change authorizations.
3. Receipts, shipment records, and delivered quantity.
4. Batch records and released quantity.
5. Quality release status and test evidence.
6. Milestone approval and deliverable acceptance.
7. Material consumption records and approved unit costs.
8. Capacity reservation and utilization records.

## 3. Changeover rules

Product changeover is billable only when Summit changes between different product families or active ingredients. Changeover between capsule strengths within the ALLER-CAP family is included in the unit production price when performed during the same campaign week.

## 3. Supplier response

Supplier communications must be specific and evidence-backed. The response should identify the invoice line, cite the controlling contract or policy term, explain the variance, and request correction, credit, backup documentation, or withdrawal of the charge.

contract_policy_sections.text:
## 3. Component scrap allowance

The unit assembly price includes component scrap up to 1.5% of sponsor-issued components per monthly campaign. Scrap above 1.5% is billable only when the scrap record shows sponsor-caused component defect or sponsor-approved process change.

## 2. Required reconciliation

Supplier invoices must be reconciled against all applicable evidence:

1. Contract terms and pricing schedules.
2. Purchase orders and approved change authorizations.
3. Receipts, shipment records, and delivered quantity.
4. Batch records and released quantity.
5. Quality release status and test evidence.
6. Milestone approval and deliverable acceptance.
7. Material consumption records and approved unit costs.
8. Capacity reservation and utilization records.

6. Recommended supplier action.

contract_policy_sections.text:
## 3. Stability study windows

Stability pull charges are billable only for pulls completed within the study schedule window or within a sponsor-approved deviation window. Early pulls, missed pulls, or replacement pulls caused by Crescent handling error are not separately billable.

## 2. Required reconciliation

Supplier invoices must be reconciled against all applicable evidence:

1. Contract terms and pricing schedules.
2. Purchase orders and approved change authorizations.
3. Receipts, shipment records, and delivered quantity.
4. Batch records and released quantity.
5. Quality release status and test evidence.
6. Milestone approval and deliverable acceptance.
7. Material consumption records and approved unit costs.
8. Capacity reservation and utilization records.

## 3. Changeover rules

Product changeover is billable only when Summit changes between different product families or active ingredients. Changeover between capsule strengths within the ALLER-CAP family is included in the unit production price when performed during the same campaign week.

## 4. Temperature-controlled storage

contract_policy_sections.text:
## 4. Customs brokerage

Customs brokerage is billable once per shipment where Valence acts as broker of record. Brokerage may not be billed on both the master shipment and child shipment records for the same customs entry.

## 5. Payment leakage categories

Common leakage categories include duplicate billing, off-contract fees, wrong rate, wrong volume, missed discount, invalid true-up, early milestone billing, unreleased batch billing, and unsupported pass-through charges.

## 4. Contamination and deviation costs

If contamination or deviation is caused by BluePeak process error, investigation, cleaning, and restart charges are not billable to the sponsor. If contamination or deviation is caused by sponsor-supplied material, charges are billable only after sponsor quality approval.

## 4. Contamination and deviation costs

If contamination or deviation is caused by BluePeak process error, investigation, cleaning, and restart charges are not billable to the sponsor. If contamination or deviation is caused by sponsor-supplied material, charges are billable only after sponsor quality approval.

## 3. Component scrap allowance

The unit assembly price includes component scrap up to 1.5% of sponsor-issued components per monthly campaign. Scrap above 1.5% is billable only when the scrap record shows sponsor-caused component defect or sponsor-approved process change.

## 2. Required reconciliation

Supplier invoices must be reconciled against all applicable evidence:

1. Contract terms and pricing schedules.
2. Purchase orders and approved change authorizations.
3. Receipts, shipment records, and delivered quantity.
4. Batch records and released quantity.
5. Quality release status and test evidence.
6. Milestone approval and deliverable acceptance.
7. Material consumption records and approved unit costs.
8. Capacity reservation and utilization records.

### 3.2 Packaging authorization

Standard bottle packaging is included in the unit production price. Blister packaging, sample packs, relabeling, or market-specific cartons are billable only when the purchase order or written change authorization identifies the packaging format.

## 3. Component scrap allowance

The unit assembly price includes component scrap up to 1.5% of sponsor-issued components per monthly campaign. Scrap above 1.5% is billable only when the scrap record shows sponsor-caused component defect or sponsor-approved process change.

## 2. Required reconciliation

4. Batch records and released quantity.
5. Quality release status and test evidence.
6. Milestone approval and deliverable acceptance.
7. Material consumption records and approved unit costs.
8. Capacity reservation and utilization records.

## 4. Contamination and deviation costs

## 6. Escalation

Escalate disputes involving repeated supplier behavior, quality status conflicts, sensitive product information, IP-sensitive process terms, or potential compliance impact.

contract_policy_sections.text:
## 3. Component scrap allowance

The unit assembly price includes component scrap up to 1.5% of sponsor-issued components per monthly campaign. Scrap above 1.5% is billable only when the scrap record shows sponsor-caused component defect or sponsor-approved process change.

## 2. Required reconciliation

Supplier invoices must be reconciled against all applicable evidence:

1. Contract terms and pricing schedules.
2. Purchase orders and approved change authorizations.
3. Receipts, shipment records, and delivered quantity.
4. Batch records and released quantity.
5. Quality release status and test evidence.
6. Milestone approval and deliverable acceptance.
7. Material consumption records and approved unit costs.
8. Capacity reservation and utilization records.
